actions.tooltip: WrapInJust: place a0 inside Just. This is the only thing pure does — no logic, no failure.

objects.tooltip: a0 — any plain value to be lifted into the Maybe context.
Just a0 : Maybe a — always Just. pure never produces Nothing; that would violate the monad laws.
